name: btc-5m-binary-fade-flow-pooled
_hypothesis: The fade + flow signal at the sized risk block, unchanged, tested against a bar sized to the effect it appears to have. Two pre-registered fresh years have been run on this signal: the year ending 2023-09-13 (54.21% on 4,964 bets, +2.21%, significant; halted only under the earlier, unsized risk block) and the year ending 2022-09-13 (53.23% on 5,020 bets, +1.23%, 1.8 standard errors). Pooled, 53.71% on 9,962 bets, +1.71%, about 3.4 standard errors. A single year of 5,000 bets has a standard error of 0.7%, so a per-year bar of two standard errors needs +1.4% and a true +1.2% edge clears it less than half the time; that bar was underpowered for this effect. This hypothesis is that the edge is real at about +1.2% and shows it when three fresh years are read together.
_decisions: Every value was chosen by the person building the strategy, one at a time, with the evidence and the run it came from recorded in DECISIONS.md. Decision 1: keep the fade gate and add order flow. Decision 2: taker_flow reads the bar's own share, faded (the last 1, 2 and 3 minutes before the open were measured and were weaker). Decisions 3 and 4, chosen together: a |z| floor of 2.0 and no volume floor. Decision 5: the z-score span stays one day. Decision 6: either gate may fire, a disagreement is refused (betting.mode weighted, allow_dissent false). Decision 7: the taker vote is flat (score_span 0); the conviction floor of 0.85 and every fade-gate value are the fade config's, unchanged. Decision 8: risk sizing, a stake of 0.10% of bankroll with the 15% drawdown limit kept (option b of a, b, c in DECISIONS.md), chosen on four sizings run over the four seen years. Every gate value, the wiring, the vote and the conviction floor are byte-for-byte the second hypothesis's. Decision 9: the bar is pooled over three fresh years rather than one, chosen after the third run and before the fourth fetch; no gate, betting or risk value changes. Every value is byte-for-byte configs/fade-flow-sized-5m.json.
_protocol: Fixed on 2026-09-13 BEFORE the fresh holdout -- the year ending 2021-09-13 -- was fetched or examined by anything in this repository. Pre-registered pass criterion, pooled over the three fresh years under this one config: the year ending 2021-09-13 (never fetched before this run) and the years ending 2022-09-13 and 2023-09-13 (each fetched once before, as the fresh holdout of an earlier pre-registered run, and burned for everything but this pooling). (a) The pooled hit rate beats the 52.00% break-even by at least +1.0%; (b) by at least 2 standard errors of the pooled estimate; (c) the year ending 2021-09-13 does not halt. Anything less fails. What that asks of the new year, given the two already known: a hit rate of roughly 52.4% or better. If the signal were worthless the bar would still pass about one time in four on the strength of the earlier years; if the edge is +1.2% it passes about seven times in eight. Both numbers are written here so the result is read with them. The years ending 2024-09-13 (development), 2025-09-13 and 2026-09-13 are reported for reference and are outside the bar. The holdout is touched once; this file is not edited after that run.
_params_pinned: Every gate parameter is written out rather than inherited. Relative to configs/fade-flow-sized-5m.json no value differs; only the name and these notes.
